answer: New identities mature slowly: each locks 10 POA and logs 30 days of distinct signed activity, one verified task per day, before payouts begin at 10% and ramp 10% per epoch. A fake copying another identity's activity is caught like a relic exposed by a shifting dune — identical outputs slash the bond and reset the clock. Each extra fake needs its own 30-day history, so 100 fakes cost 100 parallel months of tending while the tide of honest activity rises one identity at a time. The log and payout schedule are on-chain, so any verifier replays the signatures and checks every ramp.
